# T13 — Closure review (rework, 2026-11-22)

Project: T13 — Tool platform · Tranche 3 · Plan: SPEC_V2 §12 · Issue #76
Reopened under the owner's 2026-11-21 scope change; reworked through the full lifecycle and
reviewed at the tr3 record.

## Outcome vs acceptance

| Clause | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| A development job calls coding through the broker (not `nonagenticai_mcp_server`) | `tool_platform.rs::a_bound_job_calls_coding_through_the_broker`; `tools.call` → `broker` | pass |
| One `tool_call` ledger row per call | `tool_platform.rs::one_call_is_one_ledger_row` | pass |
| A destructive call without the tenant's approvals is refused before the destination | `tool_platform.rs::a_destructive_call_without_approvals_is_refused`; `a_binding_ceiling_cannot_be_raised_at_run_time` | pass |
| Schema-invalid input is refused before the backend call | `tool_platform.rs::a_closed_schema_refuses_before_the_call` (422, zero hits) | pass |
| A tenant-prefixed object round-trips; the compiled prompt carries no S3 key | `tool_platform.rs::a_job_round_trips_a_tenant_prefixed_object`, `::the_compiled_prompt_carries_no_s3_key`; `storage.put`/`storage.get` tests | pass |
| The binding writer, release grant, redaction and long operations | `v1-p111-1`, `v1-p111-2`, `v1-p111-3`, `v1-w4a-5` implemented with named tests | pass |

## Open items

These are not satisfied and not waived:

- **`v1-w4a-6`** — the BYO tool publication surface is T15's mechanism.
- **`v1-p119-1`, kata half** — the schema-drift kata is re-anchored to T5 by the programme

- **`v1-u5a-tool-idempotency-publish-1`** and **`v1-p118-2`** — two P2s remain open.

The programme gate stays red until these clear. This closure records the project's own acceptance
and names the open items; it is not a programme-wide green and it waives nothing.

## Decision

At the tr3 snapshot (manifest `bb38b11e`), 14 of 16 T13 checks pass; the two remaining are the
closure gate this request opens and the aggregate gate line it discharges. The closure request is
decided by an approver distinct from its requester and closed through `projects.close`.
reason: Rework complete through tr3; closure decided on the manifest with the open items named.
